transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because elevators really scare me. I know they’re probably not actually dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I feel like I’m going to get trapped, and I just can’t make myself feel normal about it.
Do you also feel this kind of fear in other places where it might be hard to get out, like buses, trains, or crowded spaces?
Not really, no. I mean, crowded places can be annoying, but I don’t get that same fear. It’s mainly elevators for me.
When you get into an elevator, do you suddenly have a panic attack?
It’s pretty sudden, yeah. As soon as the doors start closing, my chest gets tight and my hands start sweating. I just think, I need to get out, even if it’s only a couple floors.
Have you ever had one of these panic attacks when you were not in or about to enter an elevator?
No, I don’t think so. It’s really only when I’m getting into an elevator or I’m already in one.
